routes.name: categories.create

params.name: name
params.summary: The name.

params.name: type
params.summary: INCOME or EXPENSE.

routes.summary: Makes a category. Its name is 1 to 50 characters and unique among the categories of that type.

routes.name: categories.rename

params.name: id
params.summary: The category.

params.name: name
params.summary: The new name.

routes.summary: Renames a category. Its type cannot change.

routes.name: categories.delete

params.name: id
params.summary: The category.

params.name: month
params.summary: The month the span counts from, like 2026-10.

params.name: span
params.summary: How far it reaches: ONLY (the default), FORWARD or ALL.

routes.summary: Deletes a category: it is no longer offered or budgeted, and its transactions keep it. With a month and a span, ONLY keeps the category and removes just that month's budget, FORWARD removes it from that month on (earlier months keep its budget and spending), ALL removes it from every month. Give month and span together, or neither.

routes.name: categories.reorder

params.name: ids
params.summary: Every active category of one type, in the new order.

routes.summary: Puts the categories of one type in a new order; give every active category of that type.

params.name: name
params.summary: What it was, 1 to 50 characters.

params.name: amount
params.summary: More than zero, like 12.50.

params.name: paymentDate
params.summary: The day it was paid.

params.name: categoryId
params.summary: The category. Its type decides whether this is income or an expense.

params.name: description
params.summary: A note.

params.name: clientUuid
params.summary: A fresh UUID per transaction, so a retry cannot record it twice.

routes.summary: Records a transaction. With a clientUuid, sending the same request again gives back the first transaction instead of making another.

routes.name: transactions.update

params.name: id
params.summary: The transaction.

params.name: name
params.summary: The new name.

params.name: amount
params.summary: The new amount, more than zero.

params.name: paymentDate
params.summary: The new date.

params.name: categoryId
params.summary: The new category.

params.name: description
params.summary: The new note, or null to clear it.

routes.summary: Changes a transaction. Fields left out stay as they are; a null description clears it.

routes.name: transactions.delete

params.name: id
params.summary: The transaction.

routes.summary: Deletes a transaction. The change history keeps what it said.

routes.name: budgets.set

params.name: type
params.summary: INCOME or EXPENSE.

params.name: month
params.summary: The month, like 2026-10.

params.name: amountLimit
params.summary: The most to spend, or the aim to earn, each month. Zero is allowed.

params.name: categoryId
params.summary: The category. Leave out for the global budget of that side.

params.name: span
params.summary: How far it reaches: ONLY (the default), FORWARD or ALL.

routes.summary: Sets a monthly budget: the global budget of a side, or one category's. Span ONLY (the default): a month that has already started changes only that month; this month and later ones carry the new amount forward. FORWARD: that month and every later one. ALL: every month back to the first budget month. A category budget must match the category's type.

routes.name: budgets.remove

params.name: type
params.summary: INCOME or EXPENSE.

params.name: month
params.summary: The month, like 2026-10.

params.name: categoryId
params.summary: The category. Leave out for the global budget of that side.

params.name: span
params.summary: How far it reaches: ONLY (the default), FORWARD or ALL.

routes.summary: Removes a budget, with the same month and span rules as setting one (ONLY, FORWARD or ALL). With ONLY or FORWARD the months before keep it, and the history stays.

routes.name: recurring.create

params.name: name
params.summary: What it is, 1 to 50 characters.

params.name: amount
params.summary: The planned amount. Leave out for a bill that changes every time.

params.name: categoryId
params.summary: The category.

params.name: startDate
params.summary: The first due date. Later dates are worked out from it.

params.name: intervalUnit
params.summary: DAY, WEEK, MONTH or YEAR.

params.name: intervalCount
params.summary: Every how many units, 1 to 1000.

params.name: endDate
params.summary: The last day it can fall due.

params.name: description
params.summary: A note.

routes.summary: Adds a recurring item: a bill or an income that comes back every so many days, weeks, months or years.

routes.name: recurring.update

params.name: id
params.summary: The recurring item.

params.name: name
params.summary: The new name.

params.name: amount
params.summary: The new planned amount, or null for no fixed amount.

params.name: categoryId
params.summary: The new category.

params.name: startDate
params.summary: The new first due date.

params.name: intervalUnit
params.summary: DAY, WEEK, MONTH or YEAR.

params.name: intervalCount
params.summary: Every how many units, 1 to 1000.

params.name: endDate
params.summary: The new last day, or null for none.

params.name: description
params.summary: The new note, or null to clear it.

routes.summary: Changes a recurring item. Fields left out stay as they are; null clears the end date or the description, and a null amount makes it a bill with no fixed amount.

routes.name: recurring.delete

params.name: id
params.summary: The recurring item.

routes.summary: Deletes a recurring item. The transactions it already made stay.

routes.name: recurring.pay

params.name: id
params.summary: The recurring item.

params.name: amount
params.summary: What was paid. Defaults to the planned amount.

params.name: paidOn
params.summary: The day it was paid. Defaults to today in the app's time zone.

params.name: dueDate
params.summary: Pay this one occurrence: on or after the next due date, and not already paid or skipped.

params.name: description
params.summary: Replaces the item's note on the transaction. Empty clears it.

routes.summary: Turns the current occurrence into a transaction and moves the item to the next one. With a due date, pays that one later occurrence instead and leaves the current one due. A bill with no fixed amount needs the amount.

routes.name: recurring.skip

params.name: id
params.summary: The recurring item.

params.name: dueDate
params.summary: Skip this one occurrence: on or after the next due date, and not already paid or skipped.

routes.summary: Passes over the current occurrence without making a transaction. With a due date, skips that one later occurrence instead.

routes.name: recurring.pause

params.name: id
params.summary: The recurring item.

routes.summary: Pauses a recurring item: it stops coming due until it is resumed.

routes.name: recurring.resume

params.name: id
params.summary: The recurring item.

routes.summary: Resumes a paused recurring item, unless its next date is past its end date.

routes.name: recurring.end

params.name: id
params.summary: The recurring item.

routes.summary: Ends a recurring item for good: it becomes inactive and its end date is today. What it already paid stays.

routes.name: debts.reminders

params.name: everyDays
params.summary: The period in days, 0 to 365.

Every friend whose balance is not zero is reminded this many days after the day their debt last changed (the latest line of their statement), and again after as many; 0 is none. The app rings them (a device sets its own period and time of day); this only reads what they would be about.

params.summary: LENT (you lent), BORROWED (you borrowed), REPAID_TO_ME (they paid you back) or REPAID_BY_ME (you paid them back).

params.name: amount
params.summary: More than zero.

params.name: date
params.summary: The day it happened.

params.name: note
params.summary: A note, up to 200 characters.

params.name: transactionId
params.summary: A transaction this belongs to.

params.name: expenseName
params.summary: BORROWED only: the name of the expense that is made for your share (1 to 50 characters). Needs expenseCategoryId.

params.name: expenseCategoryId
params.summary: BORROWED only: the expense category for your share. Needs expenseName.

routes.summary: Records money lent, borrowed or paid back with a friend. It is never income or expense. For a borrowing, give expenseName and expenseCategoryId to add your share to your expenses in the same step, with the entry linked to it.

params.name: id
params.summary: The entry.

params.name: personId
params.summary: The friend.

params.name: kind
params.summary: LENT, BORROWED, REPAID_TO_ME or REPAID_BY_ME.

params.name: amount
params.summary: More than zero.

params.name: date

params.name: note

params.name: transactionId

routes.summary: Changes an entry of the ledger. Fields left out stay as they are; a null note or transactionId clears it. The expense it came with is not changed.

routes.name: ledger.delete

params.name: id
params.summary: The entry.

routes.summary: Deletes an entry of the ledger. The balance of the friend changes by that much. The change history keeps what it said.

routes.name: transactions.split

params.name: id
params.summary: The transaction.

params.name: mode
params.summary: How the numbers are typed: EQUAL (everyone the same), PERCENT (two decimals, 100.00 in all), SHARES (whole numbers) or EXACT (amounts that add up to the bill).

params.name: mine
params.summary: Your own value, typed the way the mode says. Leave out for an equal split, or to take the rest in PERCENT and EXACT.

params.name: people
params.summary: The friends the bill is shared with, as ids.

params.name: guests
params.summary: People who are not tracked, by name, separated by commas. Their part leaves your cost and makes no debt.

params.name: values
params.summary: The value of each friend, in the order of --people, then of each guest, separated by commas. Not for an equal split.

routes.summary: Shares a transaction with friends and guests. It keeps the amount that was paid; your part, the amount minus theirs, is what budgets and statistics count. The numbers must add up. Only an expense can be shared.

routes.name: transactions.unsplit

params.name: id
params.summary: The transaction.

routes.summary: Takes the split off a transaction: it costs you its whole amount again, and the friends' balances go down by their parts.

routes.name: recurring.split

params.name: id
params.summary: The recurring item.

params.name: mode
params.summary: How the numbers are typed: EQUAL (everyone the same), PERCENT (two decimals, 100.00 in all), SHARES (whole numbers) or EXACT (amounts that add up to the bill).

params.name: mine
params.summary: Your own value, typed the way the mode says. Leave out for an equal split, or to take the rest in PERCENT and EXACT.

params.name: people
params.summary: The friends the bill is shared with, as ids.

params.name: guests
params.summary: People who are not tracked, by name, separated by commas. Their part leaves your cost and makes no debt.

params.name: values
params.summary: The value of each friend, in the order of --people, then of each guest, separated by commas. Not for an equal split.

routes.summary: Splits every payment of a recurring item the same way, from now on. Kept as proportions, so a payment that differs from the plan is shared in the same proportions. EXACT needs an item with an amount that the values add up to. Payments already made are not changed.

routes.name: recurring.unsplit

params.name: id
params.summary: The recurring item.

routes.summary: Takes the split off a recurring item: its payments are not split from now on. Payments already made keep theirs.

routes.name: export.debts

params.name: what
params.summary: SUMMARY (the default), STATEMENT or LEDGER.

params.name: format
params.summary: TEXT (the default), CSV or PDF. LEDGER is CSV only.

params.name: personId
params.summary: The friend, for a STATEMENT.

routes.summary: Writes who owes what to a text, CSV or PDF file, in English, after the person allows it in the app: the SUMMARY of all friends, the STATEMENT of one friend (personId), or the LEDGER of every entry as CSV. An existing file is never replaced.
